author: sysko

english.text: Do you speak English?

jyutping: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 jing1 man4？
text: 你識唔識講英文？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you do not go fishing tomorrow, I will not either.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ting1 jat6 m4 heoi3 diu3 jyu4，ngo5 dou1 m4 heoi3 laa3。
text: 如果你聽日唔去釣魚，我都唔去喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can hardly stand his behavior.

jyutping: keoi5 zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 je5，ngo5 zan1 hai6 deng2 keoi5 m4 seon6。
text: 佢做埋啲咁嘅嘢，我真係頂佢唔順。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He will come soon.

jyutping: keoi5 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 lai4 gaa3 laa3。
text: 佢好快就會嚟㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You may choose whichever you like.

jyutping: jam6 nei5 gaan2。
text: 任你揀。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The boy fell off the bed.

jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 hai2 zoeng1 cong4 dou6 dit3 zo2 lok6 lai4。
text: 個細路喺張床度跌咗落嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can put up with a house being untidy, but I don't like it to be dirty.

jyutping: di1 uk1 gau2 dau3 gam3 lyun6 ngo5 dou1 ding2 dak1 seon6，daan6 hai6 wu1 zou1 ge3 waa2 ngo5 zau6 zip3 sau6 m4 dou3。
text: 啲屋狗竇咁亂我都頂得順，但係污糟嘅話我就接受唔到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She has three sisters: one is a nurse and the other two are teachers.

jyutping: keoi5 jau5 saam1 go3 zi2 mui6，jat1 go3 hai6 wu6 si6，ling6 ngoi6 go2 loeng5 go3 hai6 lou5 si1。
text: 佢有三個姊妹，一個係護士，另外嗰兩個係老師。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Beth has a strong habit of interrupting people while they are talking.

jyutping: bui3 si1 hou3 zung1 ji3 hai2 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 go2 zan6 gaa1 baa2 hau2 lok6 heoi3。
text: 貝絲好鍾意喺人哋講嘢嗰陣加把口落去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I ran across your mother in the library.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 dou6 zong6 dou3 nei5 aa3 maa1。
text: 我喺圖書館度撞到你阿媽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why didn't you try the dress on before you bought it?

jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 m4 si3 haa5 tiu4 kwan4 sin1 maai5 ge3？
text: 你做咩唔試吓條裙先買嘅？

author: kaenif

english.text: The moon moves around the earth.

jyutping: jyut6 loeng6 wai4 zyu6 dei6 kau4 zyun3。
text: 月亮圍住地球轉。

author: kaenif

english.text: This spoon is for tea.

jyutping: ne1 zi1 ci4 gang1 hai6 bei2 caa4 jung6 ge3。
text: 呢支匙羹係俾茶用嘅。

author: fercheung

english.text: Look into my eyes.

jyutping: mong6 zyu6 ngo5 deoi3 ngaan5。
text: 望住我對眼。

author: kaenif

english.text: I know a good Italian restaurant.

jyutping: ngo5 sik1 jat1 gaan1 hou2 sik6 ge3 ji3 daai6 lei6 caan1 teng1。
text: 我識一間好食嘅意大利餐廳。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Almost everyone arrived on time.

jyutping: caa1 m4 do1 go3 go3 dou1 zeon2 si4 lai4 dou3。
text: 差唔多個個都準時嚟到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's not important!
It's not important.

jyutping: m4 zung6 jiu3 gaa3！
text: 唔重要㗎！

author: nickyeow

english.text: The lecture was a total snoozefest.

jyutping: tong4 fo3 mun6 dou3 cau1 gan1。
text: 堂課悶到抽筋。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I forgot to tell you my phone number.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 bei2 ngo5 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 nei5。
text: 我唔記得俾我電話號碼你。

author: cheeseisdisgusting

english.text: Be careful about the aluminum foil covering the bottom of the plate, don't burn yourself!

jyutping: siu2 sam1 go2 di1 sek3 zi2 ze1 zyu6 zo2 dip6 dai2，m4 hou2 laat6 can1 aa1！
text: 小心嗰啲錫紙遮住咗碟底，唔好辣親啊！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why do I get hiccups every time I eat spicy food?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 ngo5 sik6 can1 laat6 je5 dou1 wui5 daa2 si1 jit3 ge3？
text: 點解我食親辣嘢都會打思噎嘅？

english.text: By the 2020s, GII was criticized by many, saying that its indices included many factors that had nothing to do with innovation, such as GII's inclusion of "how easy to pay taxes" was criticized for not being there at all innovation.

jyutping: dou3 zo2 2020 nin4 doi6，GII sau6 m4 siu2 jan4 pai1 ping4，waa6 keoi5 di1 zi2 sou3 baau1 ham4 zo2 hou2 do1 tung4 cong3 san1 mou5 mat1 gwaan1 hai6 ge3 jan1 sou3，lai6 jyu4 GII baau1 maai4「jau5 gei2 ji6 gaau1 seoi3」zoi6 noi6 zau6 bei2 jan4 pai1 ping4 waa6 gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 dou6 gan2 cong3 san1。
text: 到咗 2020 年代，GII 受唔少人批評，話佢啲指數包含咗好多同創新冇乜關係嘅因素，例如 GII 包埋「有幾易交稅」在內就俾人批評話根本唔係度緊創新。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: The opinions that are held with passion are always those for which no good ground exists; indeed the passion is the measure of the holder's lack of rational conviction. Opinions in politics and religion are almost always held passionately.

jyutping: jit6 cing4 ci4 jau5 ge3 ji3 gin3 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 mou5 hou2 leon6 dim2 ge3 ji3 gin3；kei4 sat6，gik1 cing4 hai6 hang4 loeng6 ci4 jau5 gik1 cing4 ge3 jan4 kyut3 fat6 seon3 nim6 ge3 fong1 faat3。hai2 zing3 zi6 tung4 zung1 gaau3 jap6 min6，ji3 gin3 gei1 fu4 dou1 hai6 jit6 cing4 gam2 ci4 jau5 hoi1 ge3。
text: 熱情持有嘅意見永遠都係冇好論點嘅意見；其實，激情係衡量持有激情嘅人缺乏信念嘅方法。喺政治同宗教入面，意見幾乎都係熱情噉持有開嘅。
